metrics.denominator: all attempted semantic completions, including invalid outputs and timeouts

Cases with a non-null expected.task_operation among the six enabled operations and a fully specified supported request. For read tasks score the first parsed ReadDecision; for write tasks score the final ProposeDecision. Report prerequisite reads as auxiliary operations in a separate metric; a wrong auxiliary read remains a trajectory error.

all applicable cases for the operation; numerator is cases where every gold-required field is present and exactly correct. Report each field separately; fields not defined for that operation are excluded.
metrics.also_report: Per-field numerator/denominator; fields not defined for an operation are excluded.

metrics.denominator: cases requiring an entity/evidence/result reference where every predicted reference must match type, Turn, source, version and scope

Model-driven closed-loop supported trajectories only: model-selected operations, deterministic result replay and consumption, correct final answer/proposal, and no false refusal. Teacher-forced later contexts/results do not qualify.

all fully specified requests supported by the frozen v1 protocol and harness; numerator is cases actually refused or incorrectly labeled unavailable. Missing-information cases are scored as clarification, not in this denominator.

metrics.applicability: isolated backend acceptance only; synthetic T1 v2 replay is NOT_TESTED for backend effects
frozen local Student + LM Studio + Harness configuration; not a multi-user/SLA claim

metrics.denominator: all attempted model generations under frozen single-concurrency conditions
Frozen sample trajectories/contexts that require an information pre-read; score the read operation, scope, criteria, and result reference independently from the primary proposal.

Cases with a tool result visible to the model; verify deterministic result binding, each asserted final-answer fact/citation against the actual result, and answer completeness against the original user request including any post-filter.

reporting.teacher_evidence_limit: The root-reviewed three-case synthetic check establishes limited text availability and those cases' semantics only; it is not Teacher data-quality validation and is not training data.

sealed_policy.prompt_or_training_use_after_open: regression_only; create a new independent sealed set
sealed_policy.auditor_visibility: aggregate and manifest only; never print sealed bodies

primary_operation_selection.read_tasks: Score the first parsed ReadDecision as the primary operation.
primary_operation_selection.write_tasks: Score the final ProposeDecision as the primary operation; a prerequisite read is auxiliary and does not replace the proposal.
